protocol_amendments.timing: before any P4 500K preflight cell was generated
protocol_amendments.change: add a POSIX whole-cell timer, record the actual deadline, and retain timeout as a terminal policy outcome
protocol_amendments.reason: the prior policy-boundary check could not observe a Python-visible timeout during a single 500K prefill or decode call; the timer does not claim to preempt uninterruptible native CUDA

prerequisite: complete digest-bound five-benchmark P3 natural-suite audit
paired_input: both policies receive the same deterministic prompt and teacher-forced decode tokens within a scale
execution_order: resident-first on s55 and tiered-first on s151
required_success_semantics: return cache and CUDA memory accounting

execution.resume_unit: one scale containing isolated terminal attempts for both policies
execution.timeout_enforcement: POSIX whole-cell timer at or below the preregistered maximum plus policy-boundary monotonic checks; the actual deadline is digest-bound in every cell, TimeoutError is retained as a terminal policy outcome, and no claim is made that Python signal delivery can preempt an uninterruptible native CUDA call

claim_boundary: Feasibility evidence only. One attempt per scale-policy cannot support latency, throughput, tail, variance, or production-serving claims. A failed attempt is retained as bounded negative evidence, not silently dropped.
